claims.claim: Hobb says her first choice of research source is a person who will tell her about a trade such as bee-keeping or navigating.
claims.source: Robin Hobb, interviewed by Syl R. Martin, 2023
claims.quote: I like to use people as sources

claims.claim: Hobb says diaries and other first-person accounts are her preferred sources for older technology.
claims.source: Robin Hobb, interviewed by Syl R. Martin, 2023
claims.quote: Diaries or other first person accounts are great

claims.claim: Hobb says transplanting a real person or event into an invented world is simply not believable.
claims.source: Robin Hobb, interviewed by Syl R. Martin, 2023

claims.claim: Hobb objects to screen fights after which no one is bruised, there is no blood and no one limps.
claims.source: Robin Hobb, interviewed by Madalen Erez, Paw Print, 2020
claims.quote: no one is bruised afterwards, there is no blood, no one limps

claims.claim: Hobb says being a good character does not protect a person from physical damage.
claims.source: Robin Hobb, interviewed by Madalen Erez, Paw Print, 2020
claims.quote: Having a good character does not protect you from physical damage

claims.claim: Hobb says the things that happen to us change us, and that this is what makes a character interesting.
claims.source: Robin Hobb, interviewed by Madalen Erez, Paw Print, 2020
claims.quote: The things that happen to us change us

claims.claim: Hobb says we are all the sum of our experiences, good and bad.
claims.source: Robin Hobb, interviewed by Madalen Erez, Paw Print, 2020
claims.quote: We are all the sum of our experiences, good and bad

claims.claim: Hobb says characters are shaped by their experiences and become the product of what has been done to them.
claims.source: Robin Hobb, interviewed by Madalen Erez, Paw Print, 2020
claims.quote: We become the product of what has been done to us

claims.claim: Hobb says writing a viewpoint character means putting that character on like donning a coat.
claims.source: Robin Hobb, interviewed by Madalen Erez, Paw Print, 2020
claims.quote: the writer must put that character on like donning a coat

claims.claim: Hobb says first person makes her rely on the reader to be alert and connect the dots.
claims.source: Robin Hobb, interviewed by Rob Bedford, SFFWorld, 2005
claims.quote: rely on the reader to be alert and connect the dots

claims.claim: Hobb says the intimacy of first person lets the reader know things the protagonist would not otherwise verbalise.
claims.source: Robin Hobb, interviewed by Rob Bedford, SFFWorld, 2005
claims.quote: the reader will know things that the protagonist would not otherwise verbalize

claims.claim: Hobb says the reader may be able to see what is coming even when the narrator does not.
claims.source: Robin Hobb, interviewed by Rob Bedford, SFFWorld, 2005
claims.quote: the reader will perhaps be able to see what is coming

claims.claim: Hobb says the writing and style in the Megan Lindholm books differs substantially from the Robin Hobb books.
claims.source: Robin Hobb, interviewed by Rob Bedford, SFFWorld, 2005
claims.quote: The writing and style in those books differs substantially

claims.claim: Hobb says she writes for people who really like to know the characters.
claims.source: Robin Hobb, interviewed by Rob Bedford, SFFWorld, 2005
claims.quote: I write for people who really like to know the characters

claims.claim: Hobb says researching for a fantasy lets the writer collect the best bits of history and joggle them to fit the invented world.
claims.source: Robin Hobb, interviewed by Rob Bedford, SFFWorld, 2005
claims.quote: you get to collect all the best bits
